title: California Boys with Donkey, Camp Field - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot stamped 'JUN • 67' along the white left border. Two young boys stand in a dry, sun-drenched grassy pasture flanking a pet or working donkey (burro), holding its halter and lead line. The boy on the left wears a graphic t-shirt for the Woodcraft Rangers, a Southern California youth organization, while the boy on the right wears a classic white pocket crewneck t-shirt and light trousers. A hillside with trees and residential structures is visible in the background under a pale sky.
